items.html: And therefore AVI must first receive power from the Mochin of AA, so that afterward they too can give power in the Mochin of ZON. And therefore, in the way we explained that ZON needed the souls of the righteous to ascend in the secret of MAN, in order that they receive their Mochin, so too AVI need ZON to ascend in the secret of MAN, so that they too can receive their Mochin from AA.
